skins.name: Snowstorm Invitation
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Snowstorm Invitation. An outfit tailor-made by Karlan Trade for their affiliated business negotiators. First impressions are of the utmost importance in trade talks. Steward knows this well, and has never failed to live up to expectations.
skins.quote: Prior to his reunion with his teammates, Steward mingled with businesspeople of all nations, carefully weighing the benefits each of them could bring Kjerag.
